description: This file provides extension methods for configuring DynamoDB reminder storage options in Orleans, specifically parsing connection strings into a configuration object.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods to configure DynamoDB reminder storage options, particularly parsing connection strings.

methods.name: ParseConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a connection string to set properties on a DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions object, extracting key-value pairs like Service, SecretKey, AccessKey, capacity units, and flags.
